body.en: In the early 1960s, political institutions were emerging in Netherlands New Guinea while the territory’s future was being debated internationally. This chapter introduces the New Guinea Council period and the setting in which later negotiations took place.
body.pmy: Awal 1960-an, lembaga politik mulai tumbuh di Netherlands New Guinea sementara masa depan wilayah ini dibahas di tingkat internasional. Bab ini kasih konteks New Guinea Council deng suasana sebelum negosiasi berikut.

body.en: Indonesia and the Netherlands signed the Agreement concerning West New Guinea on 15 August 1962. It provided for transfer of administration through the United Nations Temporary Executive Authority before administration passed to Indonesia in 1963.
body.pmy: Indonesia deng Belanda tanda tangan Agreement concerning West New Guinea tanggal 15 Agustus 1962. Administrasi kemudian lewat United Nations Temporary Executive Authority sebelum pindah ke Indonesia tahun 1963.

body.en: The 1969 consultation remains central to disputes over West Papua’s political history. This site treats it as a sourced chapter: the institutional record, scholarly interpretation and Papuan accounts should be presented with clear attribution rather than flattened into a single anonymous voice.
body.pmy: Konsultasi 1969 masih jadi bagian utama dari perdebatan sejarah politik Papua Barat. Situs ini harus tampilkan catatan institusi, kajian sejarah, deng cerita orang Papua dengan atribusi yang jelas.

body.en: Indonesia enacted Law No. 21 of 2001 on Special Autonomy for Papua. Later changes to governance, provincial boundaries and the implementation of autonomy are part of the continuing institutional history of the region.
body.pmy: Indonesia sahkan UU No. 21 Tahun 2001 tentang Otonomi Khusus Papua. Perubahan berikut soal pemerintahan, batas provinsi, deng pelaksanaan otonomi jadi bagian dari sejarah institusi yang masih jalan.

title.en: History stays connected to current issues
title.pmy: Sejarah tetap nyambung ke isu sekarang

body.en: Current reporting on land, mining, displacement, representation and cultural life sits inside a longer history. The purpose of this route is to give readers enough context to move between today’s developments, persistent issues and primary sources.
body.pmy: Laporan sekarang soal tanah, tambang, pengungsian, keterwakilan, deng budaya ada di dalam sejarah yang lebih panjang. Halaman ini bantu pembaca sambung dari perkembangan sekarang ke isu lama dan sumber utama.
